scripts.dev: concurrently -n worker,web "wrangler dev --port 8787" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build: uv run pywrangler sync && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check src && uv run ruff format --check src
scripts.check: npm run lint:py && npm run typecheck:py && npm run lint:web && npm run typecheck:web
